Title: Azure Machine Learning offers logging for web services

Body.Content:
With the December 18 release of Azure Machine Learning, logging is offered to provide better diagnostics information for Web Services.
  • To enable logging, go to the Web Service Dashboard page, click Yes, and then click Save.
  • When logging is enabled, all the diagnostics and errors from the default endpoint are logged to the Azure Storage Account that is linked with the user’s workspace.
  • User's can see this storage account in the Azure portal Dashboard view of their workspace (in the bottom of the Quick Glance section).
  • Currently, logging is enabled for default endpoints only.
For more information, please see Azure Machine Learning now offers logging for web services in the Machine Learning Forum.

With the December 18 release of Azure Machine Learning, logging is offered to provide better diagnostics information for Web Services.

To enable logging, go to the Web Service Dashboard page, click Yes , and then click Save .

When logging is enabled, all the diagnostics and errors from the default endpoint are logged to the Azure Storage Account that is linked with the user’s workspace.

User's can see this storage account in the Azure portal Dashboard view of their workspace (in the bottom of the Quick Glance section).

Currently, logging is enabled for default endpoints only.

For more information, please see Azure Machine Learning now offers logging for web services in the Machine Learning Forum.
